messages.text: It's been more than 72 hours since my electric gooseneck kettle refund was processed 5 days ago. Doesn't the 72-hour validity rule mean that refund expired so you need to pay me a new refund and give me the receipt?

messages.text:
No—the 72-hour limit applies only to unpaid proposals. A refund already paid stays paid and does not expire. (refund-policy/v2/validity)

Your kettle’s **BRL 107.50** refund is recorded against the order’s original payment, with receipt **R-H425-0001**. The same item cannot be refunded again. (refund-policy/v2/payment) (refund-policy/v2/remaining)

This receipt records a refund in the shop’s test ledger, not a bank transfer; the shop gives no date for money to appear on a card. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
